rule.title: Example_Suspicious_PowerShell_Download
rule.author: Rulezet tutorial
rule.description: Flags PowerShell scripts that download and run a payload in one line (IEX + DownloadString) — a classic first stage of many intrusions.
rule.content:
rule Example_Suspicious_PowerShell_Download
{
    meta:
        description = "PowerShell download-and-run one-liner"
        author = "Rulezet tutorial"
    strings:
        $iex = "IEX" nocase
        $dl1 = "DownloadString" nocase
        $dl2 = "DownloadFile" nocase
        $web = "Net.WebClient" nocase
    condition:
        $iex and $web and 1 of ($dl*)
}

bundle.title: Example: Windows initial access kit
bundle.author: Rulezet tutorial
bundle.description: A bundle groups rules of any format around one subject — here, the first steps of an intrusion on Windows — so a team can review, download or deploy them together.
